summary: A notice about the whole product, across the top of it — maintenance tonight, a trial ending, the workspace read-only or scheduled for deletion. Alert's banner layout on one line, in the app shell; a dismissal is remembered with `dismissKey`.
useWhen: the notice is about the product or the account, not about what is on this page — maintenance, an outage, a plan limit, read-only mode, a pending deletion
it must be seen on every page until it is dealt with or dismissed

useInstead.when: the notice is about one part of the page — a form, a panel, a table
useInstead.why: an Alert sits with what it is about; a banner about a form reads as a problem with the whole product

useInstead.when: a result the user just caused — saved, sent, deleted
useInstead.why: it comes and goes by itself; a banner stays until dealt with

composition.note: In the app shell, above the Header and outside <main>, so it persists across routes and is announced once. Several stack, the most severe first. `actions` holds one Link or small Button, beside the message.
composition.example: <Banner intent="information" title="Maintenance on Sunday" dismissKey="maintenance-2026-10-04" actions={<Link href="/status">Status page</Link>}>From 02:00 to 03:00 UTC.</Banner>

information.use: the default — maintenance, a new feature, a plan change

warning.use: something the user should act on — a trial ending, a deletion scheduled, read-only mode

error.use: the product is not working — an outage, a failed payment that has stopped runs

success.use: rarely — a state that has just been restored, shown once

neutral.use: a notice with no judgement attached

solid.use: one banner that must not be missed, such as an outage

requires: a message that says what is happening and what it means for the user, in words
guarantees: the role follows the intent, as Alert's does: `alert` for warning and error, `status` for the rest — announced when it is inserted, not on every page, because it lives in the shell
with `dismissKey`, dismissed stays dismissed in this browser — on every page and the next visit — and a remembered dismissal is never painted
without `dismissKey` or `onDismiss` there is no dismiss button: a banner that must stay cannot be dismissed
dismissing moves focus to the next focusable element after the banner, not to the top of the document
blocked storage — a private window — leaves it showing and dismissible for the page
title, message and action share one line where there is room, and wrap on a phone without running past the edge; it is not sticky
notes: change the key when the notice changes — `maintenance-2026-10-04`, not `maintenance` — or a user who dismissed last month's will never see this month's
more than two banners at once is a sign some of them belong elsewhere

antiPatterns.dont: a Banner inside each page's content
antiPatterns.do: one place in the app shell
antiPatterns.why: remounted on every route, a live region is announced on every route, and it moves with each page's layout
a notice the user must not forget cannot be one they can make go away

antiPatterns.do: a banner that scrolls away with the page
antiPatterns.why: stuck to the top of a phone, it takes a block of every screen for as long as it is there
